format: float32 (n_rows, 4) class logits, columns ['QCD', 'HH_4b', 'tt', 'Wjets'] (= team/data.py GROUP_ID order), rows in team/cache/<tag>/X.npy order
usage: class probabilities = softmax(logits, axis=1); binary HH-vs-background score = logits[:,1] - logsumexp(logits[:,[0,2,3]], axis=1); for KD at temperature T use softmax(logits / T, axis=1)
